# Shazam Parking

> Dubai's long-term parking marketplace: rent a verified monthly parking space, or list your unused bay and earn passive income.

Shazam Parking connects drivers who need private long-term parking in Dubai with owners of unused parking bays. Bookings are monthly, verified and paid securely.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the platform for drivers and parking owners.
- [Find a parking space](/find-a-parking-space): Browse and book verified monthly parking across Dubai.
- [Rent out your space](/rent-out-your-space): List a parking bay and start earning monthly income.
- [Earnings calculator](/calculator): Estimate monthly take-home for 1, 3, 6 and 12 month bookings.
- [About us](/about-us): Who we are and how the marketplace works.
- [FAQ](/faq): Bookings, payments, payouts, access cards and verification.
- [News](/news): Updates on Dubai parking, mobility and the platform.
